source: Official public20260409 build, formation_manager.gd, unit_shell.gd, battle_systems.gd; independently implemented from rule facts, original source remains temporary

facts.columns: max(1,round(drag_length/pitch)); rows ceil(count/columns); last partial row centered
facts.assignment: Nearest remaining person per generated slot
facts.wall_march: Exact remaining wall selection keeps slots/normal, translates targets by destination minus original target centroid
facts.column_spread: Adjacent progress limit first living body diameter*0.25; two directional passes
facts.settle: Formation inside3 units for1 second before holding
facts.return: Held shield more than17 away from held slot waits0.5s before returning
facts.hold: H keeps shield flag, removes hold-slot flag

implemented: Preserved wall right-click march and independent column locks/release
Contact geometry uses actual detached enemy positions, not transient rendered hit offsets
Source settlement/return delay; H keeps shields without forced slot return
Empty walls discarded and retry creates fresh wall list/serial
differences: Native repulsion is unavailable: same-wall personal clearance uses pitch-1 (12 for9-radius infantry) as a local approximation. Obstacle clearance remains full body radius.
Original script can produce more columns than members; local controller only visits occupied columns to avoid invalid empty front indexing.
Default map/figure scale and64x64 sprite art retained; compact wall is visually dense at default camera.
Ordinary movement idle/settling, inside-selection batches, strategic role AI and remaining units/abilities still incomplete; latest Steam build not verified.
